info.name: AI Matchmaking Model
info.description:
2 APIs:
  1. POST /users       → Backend sends all user data
  2. GET  /match/{id}  → Get matchmaking results for a user
  GET  /health         → Health check

Start: uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8010
Swagger: http://localhost:8010/docs

request.description:
Step 1: Backend sends ALL users (with profiles + partner_preferences).

Run this FIRST to load users into the model.
Edit users to add/remove/modify profiles and preferences.

exec: console.log(m.candidate_name + ' | you->them: ' + d1 + '% | them->you: ' + d2 + '% | mutual: ' + m.match_score + '% | ' + m.match_status);

request.description:
Step 2: Get matchmaking results for Ahmed.

Make sure Step 2 (Upload Users) has been run first.

Change user_ahmed to any other user_id to see their matches:
  /match/user_fatima
  /match/user_ayesha
  /match/user_zara
Get matchmaking results for Fatima. She looks for a Sunni male, 28-35, Doctor or Software Engineer.
Ahmed ke sirf top 2 matches jo 50%+ score rakhte hain.
